segments.text: Take a risk. Risk deezkondi.Fail aithi celebrate jeezkondi.Baya padhe nendir.Kindabhadangine tachibomu bhaeyi.Muttam jeevitham dalton aamthan naadhu.Kindabhatta, apadaplu debba dalgina, kutha edhuru debba dalgina, tapakonda celebrate jeezkondi.Moodavada anindika na mukhyam, enjipurna bhatani godilipettakandi.
